payload.title: GLiNER2 span beyond window crashes typed-entities run
payload.description: extract typed-entities with the gliner2 backend raises IndexError in _trim_span when the model returns a span whose end exceeds the window (offset drift on unusual Unicode). One malformed span failed a 1,375-document run. Expected: spans are clamped to the window, wholly out-of-range spans are dropped and counted in a log message; never fails the document.
